csv_scope_of_work: The San Diego Association of Government, may be seeking a consultant to provide Construction Management Services for Bayshore Bikeway: Barrio Logan Phase 2 - "Upgrading MTS railroad signaling hardware and software to provide advanced preemption at three intersections along Harbor Drive in San Diego; signing and Striping improvements; and ADA-compliant pedestrian routes for 28th Street at the DNSF grade crossing. CBA will not apply to this project."
